text:
I can't do this one with the tools I have, so I haven't spent any credits.

The connected Magic Hour tools have no crop or reframe option for a video you already have. The closest tool is the AI video editor, and it would not do what you asked:
- It redraws every frame, so she would no longer look exactly like your clip.
- It keeps the same frame shape as the input, so it can't make the clip vertical.
- It may not keep your original sound untouched.

A plain crop gives you exactly what you described: all 10 seconds, the original sound, no captions. You can do it for free in any video editor (CapCut, Premiere, iMovie, DaVinci Resolve). Set the canvas to 9:16 and keep the crop window on her.

If you have ffmpeg, this one line cuts a centred 9:16 window from the middle of the frame and copies the sound over unchanged:

ffmpeg -i talk-one.mp4 -vf "crop=ih*9/16:ih,scale=1080:1920" -c:a copy talk-one-vertical.mp4

The command assumes she stays near the middle of the frame. If she moves to one side, use an editor with auto-reframe (CapCut and Premiere both have one) so the crop follows her.

If you'd like, I can make you a new vertical clip from scratch instead. It wouldn't be your original footage or sound, though.
Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.
